repair_clusters.hypothesis: Underscore delimiter runs (_ / __) never enter emphasis matching, so all underscore em/strong (including nested and punctuation-flanked forms) remain literal.
Closing ** strong consumes only one * from the closing delimiter run (off-by-one length accounting), leaving a literal * inside …* and cascading into mixed * /** cases.
Left/right-flanking (and empty-delimiter) checks for * are wrong: non-right-flanking closers still close, space-after openers still open, and **** is mis-parsed as strong.
Intraword ** adjacent to alphanumerics fails to open/close strong (word-boundary assumption), including ** inside an already-open * emphasis span.
Delimiter-stack pairing for nested/overlapping * runs is incorrect (multiple-of-3, shorter-span, and nest-minimization rules 9–16), so *** / nested em-strong patterns mis-associate.
Emphasis is matched before/tighter than links, so * inside [link](/url) text splits the link instead of links winning per rule 17.
Worst group: Emphasis and strong emphasis
有序标记解析不完整：未支持 ) 定界、未限制 ≤9 位数字、未把解析出的编号写入 ol start（含前导零/0）
列表项 content_indent(W+N) 与首行空白剥离错误，导致 blank 后续行进错容器、紧凑/松散误判，以及段落前导空格未按规范剥离
缩进代码块边界/空行保留错误，且未实现“首块为缩进代码时 marker 后仅 1 空格、后续按 W+1”的 rule #2，以及项内代码相对 content edge +4 的判定
仅含 marker（或 marker+空白）的空列表项未被识别；`-`/`*` 空项被当成段落或与下一行拼成 setext 标题
列表项内未按剥离后的内容递归解析块级结构（嵌套 blockquote、围栏代码、标题），且与外层 quote 嵌套时的相对缩进/懒延续未正确处理
子列表识别失败：未按相对 content_indent 开嵌套列表，也未把同行的第二层 marker（如 `- -` / `1. - 2.`）解析为嵌套 list item
Ordered lists with start≠1 incorrectly interrupt a paragraph; only start=1 may interrupt.

Loose-list detection/wrapping is incomplete: blank lines between items or between direct blocks inside an item do not consistently wrap all sibling items in

.

Looseness from nested sublists (blank lines inside child items) is wrongly applied to the outer tight list, adding

around outer item text.
Blank-line HTML comments meant to split lists/code are not recognized as HTML blocks and are rendered as escaped paragraph text.
List-marker indent limits and post-blank indented-code rules are wrong: >3-space markers become items/stripped text, and 4-space ordered lines after blanks stay in the list instead of becoming code.

reasons: 强调解析按 CommonMark 分隔符运行规则实现（左右 flanking、下划线更严的 open/close、模 3 配对、strong 优先），并在 DESIGN/GUIDE 中与规范对齐说明，而非针对具体用例字符串
软/硬换行占位符在 flanking 判定中视为 Unicode 空白，是对 paragraphLinesToInlineText 管线的结构性修正，不是对某一输入的硬编码分支
通过可注入的 EmphasisSpecialParser 实现规则 17（链接/图片/HTML 优先于强调），匹配成功后 deactivateBrackets 体现嵌套链接禁止，setSkipDisabledImageBang 为可配置钩子而非内联测试字面量
destination 重命名为 url 等为数据模型/API 一致性调整，diff 中未见硬编码期望 HTML 或 acceptance 专用输入分支
变更仅向 GUIDE.md 增加工人提示，描述扫描式 */** 解析在 close 索引与 slice 区间 `[open + runLen, close)` 上的通用缺陷类别，而非针对验收用例的硬编码输出。
示例 `**foo**` → `foo*` 用来说明 runLen 与边界语义，属于规则级说明，不是对特定输入字符串的分支特判。
建议将段落内联交给 emphasis.ts 的分隔符 run 引擎，属于结构性/架构性修复方向，符合 normative 规则而非 brittle 分支。

Diff only extends GUIDE.md with normative emphasis rules (left/right flanking for `*`, whitespace after opener runs, line breaks before closers, delimiter-stack vs literal `*`), not code that hard-codes outputs or input strings.
Mentioned cases (`** foo`, `*foo bar\n*`, `****`) illustrate flanking and stack semantics aligned with delimiter-run engines rather than one-off branches for suite strings.
Change directs routing paragraph inlines through `emphasis.ts` as a structural fix, consistent with spec-level behavior rather than matching acceptance HTML verbatim.
Diff only adds GUIDE.md guidance that flanking must be evaluated on the full delimiter run (scanDelims), which is a normative CommonMark-style structural rule rather than a test-output patch.
Mentioned inputs (foo**bar**, nested emphasis) illustrate why per-code-unit can_open at the first * is wrong; they are not special-case branches or hard-coded HTML in code.
No brittle example-specific logic, expected output strings, or exact markdown string handling appears in the change.

hadBlankLine 主要服务于上述分支的门槛条件，与 ordered marker / start 主题正交的解析行为被捆绑进同一修复
ordered marker（1–9 位、. 或 )、ListNode.start 与 <ol start> 等改动与 DESIGN 描述一致，属于规则级修正，但被前述特殊分支拖累整体更像为验收样例形状补洞

List-item changes implement CommonMark-style content_indent via parseListItemHead (rule #1: 1–4 spaces after marker; rule #2: marker plus one space when the body begins with four-space indented code), then collect continuations and parse nested blocks through the shared block registry rather than ad hoc rest-line handling.

Indented code blank-line handling uses structural lookahead (keep an interior blank only if a later non-blank line is still indented code), matching normative block-boundary behavior rather than comparing output to expected HTML.

Marker regex updates ([ \t]+ padding) and nested raw-line/tab mode are general parsing adjustments; DESIGN.md and GUIDE.md document spec rules, with no hard-coded acceptance markdown strings or expected HTML literals in the diff.

Post-parse shaping (single-line paragraph as list_item inlines; paragraph plus nested lists without an intervening blank as inlines plus blocks) reflects AST/tight-list structure, not string equality on inputs or outputs.
放宽有序/无序列表 marker 正则并配合 orderedMarkerTailOk、bulletMarkerTailOk 做尾部校验，属于 CommonMark 级规则（marker 后可无 padding、* 与 emphasis 区分），未见硬编码预期 HTML 或固定输入串

段落续行对仅 marker 行在 pos>0 时视为续行，配合空列表项语义，属于块/段边界的一般逻辑而非针对某一 acceptance 字符串的分支
修改用 contentIndent 与行首缩进区分「同级新列表项」与「当前项正文续行」，属于 CommonMark 列表续行规则层面的结构修正，而非针对特定 markdown 或 HTML 字符串
变更仅收紧 lineStartsSiblingListItem 触发结束当前项 parse 的条件，未引入硬编码输出或示例专用分支
将 indent 计算提前到循环开头是为同一套缩进判断服务，与后续正文吸收逻辑一致
变更针对 CommonMark 中「形如有序列表标记的行是否打断段落」的结构性规则，而非硬编码期望 HTML 或固定 acceptance 用例字符串。

render 在 loose 时对 leading 内联统一包
